description: Copy an invisible character in one press — or paste text to find the hidden ones in it. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

character.description: One invisible character to return, by code point or name: "U+3164", "hangul filler", "zero width space", "braille pattern blank". Ignored when text is given.

spaces.description: When cleaning text: "normalise" turns unusual blank characters (no-break space, em space, Hangul filler…) into ordinary spaces; "keep" leaves them and removes only zero-width and direction-control characters.

text.description: Text to check for hidden characters (zero-width spaces, direction marks, blank fillers, tag characters). Returns each one with its position, a count per character, and the text with them removed. Omit it to get the list of invisible characters to copy instead.

name: invisible_character
title: Invisible Character
